**Title:** HTTP parser raises TransferEncodingError when chunk separators are split across data chunks

**Description:**

When processing chunked HTTP responses, if the chunk separator (`\r\n`) is split between multiple received data chunks, the HTTP payload parser raises an error instead of correctly parsing the payload.

**Example Code:**
[code block delimiter removed]python
network_chunks = (
    b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n",
    b"5\r\nfi",
    b"rst",
    b"\r\n",
    b"6",
    b"\r",
    b"\n",
    b"second\r",
    b"\n0\r\n\r\n",
)
reader = response.feed_data(network_chunks[0])[0][0][1]
for chunk in network_chunks[1:]:
    response.feed_data(chunk)

result = await reader.read()

The parser should successfully parse the payload and return `b"firstsecond"` without any errors.
